name: Eos Energy Enterprises (EOSE)
teaser: Sell, no buy zone. Counting the preferred stock and a penny warrant, Eos has 542 million share claims, not 364 million. At $2.765 the price sits above my Bull value of $2.66.
llms: Eos Energy Enterprises makes zinc-based long-duration battery storage in Pennsylvania. Gross margin was -71% in Q2 2026 after an 18% production tax credit, and 80% of revenue came from one related-party project. Counting the Series B preferred and a 44.4 million share penny warrant, there are 542 million share claims, not 364 million, against about $643 million of net debt. Valued on EV to 2027 revenue and a path-to-cash-flow model. Bear $0, Base $0.30, Bull $2.66. Verdict Sell at $2.765, no buy zone (required margin of safety 75%).
